text:
anika: vuln-scan-bot flagged two CVEs that touch our inference stacks (vLLM/Triton + FlashAttention builds). need quick triage and a patch plan. CVE-2026-12345 (sentencepiece: deserialization RCE in <=0.1.96) and CVE-2026-23456 (flash-kernel: OOB read in kernel 2.3.1).

vuln-scan-bot: automated scan result for org/redwood-inference: repo=infra-models, affected=sentencepiece<=0.1.96, severity=HIGH, cve=CVE-2026-12345, links=https://nvd.example.gov/CVE-2026-12345

lee: noted. which services currently pin sentencepiece? I think vllm-serving image uses 0.1.95 baked into the wheel. Triton GPU containers don't directly depend on sentencepiece but some preproc steps do on CPU.

priya: vllm pipelines and our batch-embedding job use sentencepiece wheel in the build container. we've got a canary of vllm-staging that we can run quick tests on.

anika: patch priority checklist proposal: 1) identify prod images with pinned vulnerable versions 2) scope exploitability (RCE requires untrusted model artifacts?) 3) create CVE PRs for each image (hotpatch or scheduled) 4) RBAC + KMS mitigations while patch lands 5) audit-log verification post-deploy. thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam: agree. for RBAC: restrict who can upload model artifacts to S3 buckets and enforce signed uploads via KMS-encrypted metadata. We should also add a short-lived presigned URL policy.

lee: for flash kernel CVE-2026-23456 — that's in the custom fused-kernels we ship. The maintainer release notes say it only triggers with crafted input sizes + dtype combos. We should run fuzz inputs in staging.

priya: running a quick grep: in the last month, three repos pinned sentencepiece: infra-models/Dockerfile: "pip install sentencepiece==0.1.95", vllm/requirements.txt, and embeddings-builder image. I'll open draft PRs to bump to 0.1.97 (patched).

anika: good. on KMS: do we need a key rotation or config change to mitigate? my thought: rotate signing key for model upload metadata so previously signed (potentially crafted) artifacts can't be uploaded silently. That buys time for patches.

sam: rotating KMS keys is possible but has rollout impact. alternative: create a new KMS key and require new uploads to use the new key. Old artifacts stay readable but won't be accepted by the upload service without re-signing. we can use that as an immediate enforcement.

lee: TL;DR on rollout windows: flash-kernel fix needs a rebuild + kernel unit tests + perf smoke. estimate: 6-8 hours of engineer work + staging validation. sentencepiece bumps are low-risk — releases show no breaking changes.

anika: suggested priority: 1) block public model uploads from untrusted accounts via RBAC + presigned policy (immediate) 2) bump sentencepiece in all images (hotpatch) 3) build patched fused-kernel image, run perf/regression, roll canary, then prod 4) KMS key-new-upload gating if we need extra protection.

priya: I'll open the three PRs to bump sentencepiece and link them here. running tests locally now.

lee: I'll start the flash-kernel reproduce + fuzzing job on a GPU staging node. posting logs here when I have results.

vuln-scan-bot: created ticket INFSEC-4927 (triage) and linked CVEs. priority=P1 for sentencepiece (RCE), P2 for flash-kernel (exploit path constrained).

anika: assigning owners: priya -> sentencepiece bumps & CI; lee -> flash-kernel patch & perf; sam -> RBAC presigned URL policy + KMS gating plan; anika -> coordinate release windows and incident-notes template. Please update INFSEC-4927 with status.

ops-bot: deploy window calendar invite created: 2026-05-14T02:00-03:30 UTC for canary + quick rollback window.

lee: quick note on testing commands — use this to validate local wheel: ```python -c "import sentencepiece as sp; print(sp.__version__)"``` and run vllm unit smoke: ```docker run --rm -e MODEL=small-v1 our-registry/vllm:staging ./smoke_test.sh```

priya: tests passing on staging for bumped wheel. opening PRs now: https://git.internal/pr/4536 , https://git.internal/pr/4537

anika: thanks team. capture RBAC changes as a short runbook: 1) deny model uploads from non-prod roles 2) require signed metadata header X-Model-Signature 3) log upload-create events to audit-log S3 and push to SIEM. I'll draft and post later. :memo:

sam: one last thing — we should add an alert rule to detect any image builds that still install sentencepiece<=0.1.96. quick grep job scheduled daily. I'll add to infra-monitoring.

anika: perfect. we'll reconvene after canary. anyone needing help ping me or update INFSEC-4927. :white_check_mark:
